_comment: Independent C-first hero-defender recoil setup for mhitu.c:mattacku -> uhitm.c:mhitm_knockback -> dothrow.c:hurtle. It wishes and zaps digging wands east and west before creating four hostile giant mummies, so the source `test_move` square is open on either side when their physical claws hit from adjacent cells. monsters.h makes the giant mummy MZ_HUGE with two physical claws; the human Wizard receives the source 30-turn invulnerable timeout, though the exact target still requires C to pass the source 1-in-6 chance and movement gates. The fixed quantity gives several ordinary chances without changing the helper. This remains a blocked variation: at segment 0 step 120 C and JS draw the same rn2(4)=0, rnd(21)=14 and d(3,4)=7, then C calls potion.c:make_stunned(knockdistance+1, TRUE) from uhitm.c:mhitm_knockback and prints 'You stagger...' while JS records note_unported('potion.c make_stunned'); the first screen/cursor mismatch is boundary 121. Keep its C artifact out of recordings/ until that separate void helper is ported.
